products.name: Janitorial and Custodial Services
products.description: Provision of cleaning, janitorial, and custodial services for commercial, educational, healthcare, and industrial facilities, delivered through in-person labor and managed service contracts.

products.name: Facilities Engineering and Maintenance Services
products.description: Engineering, maintenance, and repair services for building systems and infrastructure, including HVAC, mechanical, and electrical systems, delivered by skilled technicians on-site or through managed contracts.

products.name: Parking and Transportation Management Services
products.description: Management and operation of parking facilities and transportation logistics for commercial properties, airports, and event venues, including revenue management and staffing, delivered through various contract models.

products.name: Aviation Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive support services for airlines and airports, including passenger assistance, aircraft cabin cleaning, catering logistics, and airport transportation, delivered by specialized teams under master service agreements.

products.name: Landscaping and Turf Services
products.description: Provision of landscaping, grounds maintenance, and turf management for educational, commercial, and industrial clients, delivered by in-person crews and specialized equipment.

products.name: Technical Solutions for Facility Infrastructure
products.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of mechanical and electrical systems, including microgrid systems, UPS systems, power distribution units, and EV charging stations, delivered through engineering teams and electrical contracting.

products.name: Energy Solutions and Sustainability Services
products.description: Development, engineering, and construction of energy-saving projects, including lighting, energy efficiency upgrades, and sustainability consulting, delivered through project-based contracts and performance guarantees.

products.name: Mission Critical and Data Center Infrastructure Services
products.description: Comprehensive maintenance and emergency services for mission-critical facilities such as data centers, including UPS maintenance, electrical testing, and power distribution unit servicing, delivered by specialized technicians.

products.name: Franchised Engineering Services
products.description: Provision of engineering and technical facility services through a franchise model under the Linc Service and TEGG brands, delivered by independent franchisees using ABM’s systems and standards.

products.name: Home Goods
products.description: A range of in-house and third-party branded home goods, including commercial fans, floor and wall fans, storage and shelving units, and chairs, sold primarily through online retail channels. Products are sourced from suppliers and delivered via e-commerce platforms and a distribution network.

products.name: Pet Products
products.description: Pet supplies and related products, offered under in-house and third-party brands, distributed through online marketplaces and company e-commerce sites. Products are sourced from external suppliers and delivered via established logistics channels.

products.name: Outdoor Lifestyle Products
products.description: A variety of outdoor lifestyle products, including items for outdoor living and recreation, sourced from supply chain partners and sold through online channels. Products are distributed via a network of warehouses and third-party logistics providers.

products.name: Gardening Products
products.description: General gardening supplies, including environmental sensors, controls, and nutrients, sourced from third-party suppliers and distributed through e-commerce platforms. Products are delivered using a robust fulfillment and logistics network.

products.name: Hydroponics Supplies
products.description: Hydroponic-related items such as grow light systems, HVAC systems, water pumps, heaters, chillers, filters, nutrient and fertilizer delivery systems, and growing media, sourced from suppliers and sold online to both commercial and home cultivators.

products.name: Consumer Electronics
products.description: A selection of consumer electronics, including various devices and accessories, offered under in-house and third-party brands, sold through online marketplaces and company websites. Products are sourced from suppliers and distributed via e-commerce logistics.

products.name: Ecommerce Services for Third-Party Brands
products.description: Value-added ecommerce services for third-party products and brands, including merchandising and logistics support, leveraging proprietary data analytics and fulfillment infrastructure. Services are delivered digitally and through physical logistics operations.

products.name: Packaging Materials (via Joint Venture)
products.description: Production and supply of packaging materials for U.S. businesses, focusing on domestic manufacturing to provide reliable, sustainable, and cost-effective supply chain solutions. Delivered through a joint venture with manufacturing and logistics partners.

products.name: Online Courses
products.description: Video-based, interactive courses across domains such as business, technology, and data science, delivered digitally via Coursera's platform and mobile app, with features like quizzes, assessments, and AI-powered learning tools.

products.name: Guided Projects
products.description: Short, hands-on, in-browser projects that teach practical technical skills using real-world tools, accessible digitally without software downloads.

products.name: Specializations
products.description: Multi-course, job-relevant learning programs designed to advance skills in 3 to 6 months, delivered online and often including hands-on projects and assessments.

products.name: Professional Certificates
products.description: Industry-recognized certificate programs, including entry-level and advanced, designed to develop and verify job-ready skills in 1 to 10 months, delivered online and often co-branded with industry partners.

products.name: University Certificates
products.description: University-issued certifications of field-level expertise, earned online in 4 to 24 months, often credit-eligible and recognized by academic institutions.

products.name: MasterTrack Certificates
products.description: Modular, university-issued credentials representing a portion of a degree program, delivered online in 3 to 12 months and credit-eligible toward a full degree.

products.name: Online Degrees
products.description: Fully online bachelor’s and master’s degree programs, as well as postgraduate diplomas, offered in partnership with universities and delivered via Coursera’s digital platform.

products.name: Enterprise Learning Solutions (Coursera for Business, Campus, Government)
products.description: Customizable online learning platforms and content subscriptions for businesses, academic institutions, and government agencies, including features for program administration, analytics, and private course authoring.

products.name: Career Academy
products.description: A curated suite of entry-level Professional Certificates, Guided Projects, and skills tracks designed to equip learners with credentials for in-demand jobs, delivered online to institutions and organizations.

products.name: Coursera Plus Subscription
products.description: A subscription service providing individual learners unlimited access to the majority of Coursera’s catalog, including courses, Guided Projects, Specializations, and Professional Certificates, for a monthly or annual fee.

products.name: Roadside Billboard Advertising
products.description: Advertising services delivered via large-format billboards (including bulletins, posters, spectaculars, and wallscapes) located along major expressways, highways, and intersections. Both printed and digital formats are offered, with digital displays allowing dynamic, data-driven content updates. Structures are physically manufactured and installed, requiring permits and ongoing maintenance.

products.name: Street Furniture Advertising
products.description: Advertising services provided on public structures such as bus shelters, kiosks, and news racks, primarily in metropolitan areas and along major commuting routes. These are sold as network packages and available in both printed and digital formats, requiring physical installation and municipal contracts.

products.name: Airport Advertising
products.description: Advertising services offered across displays in commercial and private airports, including printed, digital, and experiential formats such as custom exhibits and interactive installations. Requires exclusive contracts with airport authorities and specialized operational expertise.

products.name: Transit Advertising
products.description: Advertising services on transit displays located in rail stations and on buses, trains, and trams. These are typically part of broader OOH offerings and require contracts with transit authorities.

products.name: OOH Programmatic and Automated Advertising Solutions
products.description: Digital and programmatic advertising solutions enabling automated, real-time buying and management of OOH inventory through digital marketplaces. Includes self-service and biddable platforms, leveraging data and algorithms for targeting and measurement. Delivered via proprietary and third-party digital infrastructure.

products.name: Data-Driven OOH Campaign Planning and Measurement (RADAR Platform)
products.description: Proprietary data analytics and measurement services for OOH campaigns, including audience targeting, campaign planning, amplification, and attribution. Delivered digitally via the RADAR suite, leveraging anonymized mobile location data and integration with client analytics platforms.

products.name: Creative and Operational Advertising Services
products.description: Ancillary services including ad design, printing, installation, and campaign activation for OOH advertising. Involves both in-house and third-party resources for creative production and physical deployment of advertising materials.

products.name: Specialty Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and selling specialty insurance programs focused on complex and niche risks in underserved markets, primarily through admitted and E&S insurance lines. Delivered via an agent-centric distribution model and supported by customized underwriting solutions and value-added services. Requires regulated infrastructure and disciplined underwriting.

products.name: Mortgage Origination and Servicing
products.description: Origination and servicing of agency-eligible (FHA and VA) and conventional and government mortgage loans, including selling loans to Ginnie Mae pools or secondary market investors. Involves financial capital, regulatory compliance, and ongoing loan servicing operations.

products.name: Department Store Retail Merchandise
products.description: Sale of a wide range of merchandise including apparel and accessories (men's, women's, and kids'), cosmetics, home furnishings, and other consumer goods through physical stores and digital channels under the Macy's and Bloomingdale's brands. Products are sourced from a global supplier network and delivered via in-store and online shopping experiences.

products.name: Off-Price Retail Merchandise
products.description: Sale of discounted merchandise, including apparel, accessories, cosmetics, and home goods, through off-price retail concepts such as Macy’s Backstage and Bloomingdale’s The Outlet, delivered via dedicated store formats targeting value-conscious shoppers.

products.name: Luxury Beauty and Spa Services
products.description: Retail of premium dermatological skincare, clinical treatments, fragrances, and spa services through Bluemercury stores, focusing on high-quality, personalized beauty interactions and in-person service delivery.

products.name: Private Label Brands
products.description: Development and sale of exclusive private label merchandise across apparel, accessories, home, and beauty categories under proprietary brand names, manufactured through third-party suppliers and sold in Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, and Bluemercury stores and online.

products.name: Retail Media Network Services
products.description: Provision of advertising opportunities for brand partners to reach Macy’s, Inc. customers across digital platforms, leveraging the company’s customer base and omnichannel presence. Delivered digitally via Macy’s Media Network.

products.name: Credit Card Program
products.description: Offering of private label and co-branded credit cards to customers, generating revenue through profit sharing and enhancing customer loyalty and engagement. Delivered via financial partnerships integrated with the retail ecosystem.

products.name: Local Television Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of local television stations affiliated with major networks (CBS, NBC, FOX, ABC, Telemundo, CW, etc.), producing and delivering news, entertainment, and information programming to viewers via over-the-air broadcast and digital platforms. Requires FCC-licensed infrastructure, local studios, and in-person staff.

products.name: Digital Advertising and Marketing Services
products.description: Provision of digital marketing strategies, products, and services to national and local clients through Gray Digital Media, including digital advertising on station websites, mobile apps, and other electronic content. Delivered via digital platforms and requires digital infrastructure and marketing expertise.

products.name: Retransmission Consent Services
products.description: Negotiation and provision of retransmission rights for local television station signals to cable, satellite, and other multichannel video programming distributors (MVPDs), generating fees for allowing these distributors to carry station content. Involves regulated agreements and legal compliance.

products.name: Video and Studio Production Services
products.description: Production of video content, sports programming, and entertainment through owned production companies (Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, PowerNation Studios) and studio facilities (Assembly Atlanta, Third Rail Studios). Delivered via physical production facilities and professional production teams.

products.name: Electric Motorcycles (E-motorcycles)
products.description: Electric motorcycles, including E-mopeds, E-motorcycles, and E-tricycles, are designed, assembled, and sold under the Fly E-Bike brand. These are manufactured using sourced components and assembled in the company's facility, then distributed via retail, wholesale, and online channels.

products.name: Electric Bikes (E-bikes)
products.description: Electric bikes, including city, foldable, and standard models, are designed and assembled by the company using advanced technologies and sold through retail stores, distributors, and online. Some models are tailored for food delivery workers with features like extended battery life and easy battery swap systems.

products.name: Electric Scooters (E-scooters)
products.description: Electric scooters, including various models equipped with smart features and advanced braking systems, are designed, assembled, and sold by the company through retail, wholesale, and online channels. These are targeted for urban mobility and short-distance travel.

products.name: Accessories and Spare Parts
products.description: A comprehensive line of branded accessories and spare parts, including riding gear, storage solutions, performance upgrades, and apparel, is sold to enhance or maintain the company's electric vehicles. These are distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Traditional Bikes
products.description: The company sells traditional (non-electric) bikes alongside its electric vehicle offerings, primarily through its retail and online channels.

products.name: Rental Services for E-bikes
products.description: The company offers rental services for e-bikes at select locations, facilitated through retail stores and a mobile app, providing flexible and affordable access to e-bikes for customers in certain cities.

products.name: After-Sales Services (Repair and Maintenance)
products.description: Repair, maintenance, and bodywork services for the company's electric vehicles are provided through its retail stores, including regular maintenance, battery service, and value-added services like GPS installation and theft reporting.

products.name: Extended Warranty Program (Fly E-Bike Care)
products.description: An extended warranty and maintenance program, planned for launch, will offer customers insurance-like coverage and continuous maintenance services beyond the standard manufacturer and battery warranties.

products.name: Energy Efficiency Services
products.description: Comprehensive consulting and engineering services to design, implement, and manage energy efficiency programs for utilities, public agencies, and commercial clients. Delivered through audits, program design, project management, installation, and verification, often as turnkey solutions.

products.name: Turnkey Facility and Infrastructure Projects
products.description: Design-build and turnkey delivery of facility and infrastructure improvement projects, including planning, design, construction management, commissioning, and post-project support for public and private sector clients.

products.name: Program Design and Implementation for Energy and Sustainability
products.description: Development and implementation of energy efficiency, water conservation, and renewable energy programs for utilities and government clients, including outreach, strategy, and incentive administration.

products.name: Engineering and Construction Management Services
products.description: Civil engineering, construction management, and technical consulting for infrastructure projects such as streets, bridges, water systems, and public buildings, including planning, design, permitting, and oversight for public agencies.

products.name: Building and Safety Services
products.description: Outsourced management and staffing of municipal building departments, including plan review, field inspections, code compliance, accessibility, disaster recovery, permit processing, and related services for local governments.

products.name: City Engineering and Development Review Services
products.description: Provision of city engineering, code enforcement, development plan review, and inspection services for municipalities, including support for public works, capital improvements, and compliance with building and development codes.

products.name: Disaster Recovery Services
products.description: Disaster recovery support for cities and local governments, including organizing recovery centers, fast-track plan checking, inspection, debris management, and repair of damaged infrastructure after natural disasters.

products.name: Planning and Surveying Services
products.description: Urban and infrastructure planning, land use studies, policy plan development, and surveying/mapping services for public agencies, including GIS and right-of-way engineering.

products.name: Structural and Transportation Engineering Services
products.description: Structural engineering for bridges, buildings, and transportation infrastructure, including design, evaluation, seismic retrofitting, and traffic engineering for public sector clients.

products.name: Water Resources Engineering Services
products.description: Consulting and engineering for water development, treatment, distribution, conservation, and stormwater management, including hydraulic modeling, master planning, and design of water/wastewater facilities.

products.name: District Administration Services
products.description: Administration of special districts for public agencies, including calculation of levies, billing, reporting, and financial analysis for community facilities, assessment, and improvement districts.

products.name: Financial and Economic Consulting Services
products.description: Financial consulting for public agencies, including utility rate analysis, economic development planning, real estate and market analysis, special district formation, and federal compliance reporting for municipal debt.

products.name: Cardio & Vascular Devices and Components
products.description: Design, development, and manufacturing of components, subassemblies, and finished devices for interventional cardiology, structural heart, heart failure, peripheral vascular, neurovascular, interventional oncology, electrophysiology, vascular access, infusion therapy, hemodialysis, urology, and gastroenterology procedures. Products include stents, catheters, guidewires, sheaths, implants, and related accessories, produced through advanced manufacturing and engineering processes.

products.name: Cardiac Rhythm Management Devices and Components
products.description: Design, development, and manufacturing of implantable and external devices and components for cardiac rhythm management, including implantable pulse generators (IPGs), pacemakers, defibrillators, cardiac monitors, pacing and defibrillation leads, and related accessories. Production involves advanced battery, capacitor, and feedthrough technologies, as well as precision manufacturing of leads and device enclosures.

products.name: Neuromodulation Devices and Components
products.description: Design, development, and manufacturing of implantable neuromodulation devices and components, including spinal cord stimulators, sacral nerve stimulators, deep brain stimulators, and related accessories. Products include implantable pulse generators, leads, programmer systems, battery chargers, patient controllers, and device enclosures, produced using proprietary battery and feedthrough technologies.

products.name: Medical Device Surface Coating Solutions
products.description: Manufacturing and application of high-value surface coating technologies for medical devices, including hydrophilic, hydrophobic, parylene, fluoropolymer, anodic, and ion treatment coatings. These coatings are applied to enhance device performance and are delivered as part of components or finished devices for various medical applications.

products.name: Portable Medical Device Power Solutions (Winding Down)
products.description: Design and manufacture of customized rechargeable batteries and chargers for portable medical devices such as patient monitors, ventilators, portable defibrillators, ultrasound, and X-ray machines. Products are manufactured to meet stringent quality and regulatory requirements, but this business line is being exited with final sales expected in 2026.

products.name: Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of Class A and creative office real estate assets, primarily located in vibrant metropolitan communities. Properties are physically owned, managed, and operated, requiring significant real estate investment and ongoing property management.

products.name: Hotel Operations
products.description: Ownership and operation of hotel property, including room rentals and ancillary services such as parking. Involves physical property management, hospitality services, and regulated operations.

products.name: Multifamily Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of premier multifamily residential properties situated in high-growth, high-density communities. Involves acquisition, development, ownership, and ongoing management of apartment buildings.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending (SBA 7(a) Loans)
products.description: Origination of loans to small businesses, primarily under the SBA 7(a) loan program. This business line involved financial capital and regulatory compliance, but was divested in January 2026.

products.name: Online Insurance Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform that connects consumers shopping for property and casualty (P&C) insurance with insurance providers (carriers and agents), using proprietary data and technology to match high-intent consumers with relevant insurance options. The marketplace operates through owned-and-operated websites, third-party publisher sites, and call centers, delivering consumer referrals to insurance providers.

products.name: Insurance Provider Campaign Management Tools
products.description: Web-based tools and a provider portal that allow insurance carriers and agents to manage, target, and optimize their marketing campaigns, access marketplace data, and integrate with internal workflows for acquisition and retention efforts. These tools include campaign management, data analytics, and integration capabilities.

products.name: Women's Fashion Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Trend-driven, in-house designed women's clothing and accessories sold primarily online, through retail stores, and via wholesale partnerships. Products are manufactured through a global network of suppliers and delivered via direct-to-consumer e-commerce, physical stores, and third-party retailers.

products.name: Men's Streetwear Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Fashion-forward men's streetwear, including in-house designed and third-party branded apparel, footwear, and accessories, sold online, in experiential retail stores, and through wholesale channels. Products are sourced from international suppliers and delivered via direct-to-consumer and retail experiences.

products.name: Experiential Retail Store Shopping
products.description: Immersive, in-person retail experiences featuring exclusive fashion products, event-driven activations, live entertainment, and interactive elements. Stores serve as both sales channels and brand engagement hubs, primarily for Culture Kings and Princess Polly.

products.name: Wholesale and Marketplace Distribution of Fashion Brands
products.description: Distribution of owned fashion brands through third-party retailers, department stores, and online marketplaces, expanding reach beyond direct-to-consumer channels. Products are sold via partnerships with retailers such as Nordstrom, Amazon, and Stitch Fix.

products.name: Distributed Renewable Energy Investments
products.description: Investments in behind-the-meter distributed renewable energy projects, including residential, commercial, industrial, and community solar power and energy storage, as well as energy efficiency improvements. These are typically delivered through financing structures secured by installed improvements or real estate rights.

products.name: Utility-Scale Renewable Energy Investments
products.description: Investments in grid-connected, utility-scale renewable energy projects, including solar, solar-plus-storage, and wind power. These are typically structured as equity or debt investments, with returns derived from long-term contracts such as power purchase agreements with utilities or wholesale market participants.

products.name: Sustainable Fuels, Transportation, and Nature Investments
products.description: Investments in infrastructure assets designed to reduce emissions or provide environmental benefits beyond the power grid, such as renewable natural gas (RNG) plants, transportation fleet decarbonization, and ecological restoration projects. Delivered through various financing structures to industrial, utility, and transportation clients.

products.name: Sustainable Infrastructure Asset Management Services
products.description: Management and servicing of sustainable infrastructure assets, including fee-generating co-investment structures and securitization trusts, providing ongoing asset management and servicing for institutional investors.

products.name: Regional Retail Center Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail, entertainment, and service space in large, enclosed, climate-controlled shopping centers (regional malls) to a variety of tenants, including national and regional retailers, anchors, and entertainment providers. This involves physical real estate ownership, management, and leasing operations.

products.name: Community/Power Shopping Center Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail and service space in mid-sized, open-air shopping centers (community/power centers) typically anchored by supermarkets, discount department stores, or drug stores. These centers are physically managed and leased to external tenants.

products.name: Outparcel and Freestanding Retail Asset Leasing and Sales
products.description: Leasing and sale of outparcels and freestanding retail properties located on or adjacent to shopping center sites, including big box stores and retail strips. These are physically distinct assets that may be leased or sold to external tenants or buyers.

products.name: Property Management and Leasing Services for Third Parties
products.description: Provision of property management and leasing services to third-party owners of shopping centers, delivered through in-person management teams and leasing professionals. This is a service business line distinct from managing the company's own properties.

products.name: Mixed-Use Property Leasing (Office, Hotel, Residential Adjacent to Centers)
products.description: Leasing of office, hotel, and residential space that is physically developed adjacent to or as part of shopping center properties. This involves real estate development and management of non-retail space for external tenants.

products.name: Cancer Insurance
products.description: Individually underwritten and group cancer insurance policies providing lump-sum and treatment benefits for cancer diagnosis and care, delivered through independent agents and corporate channels in Japan and the U.S. Requires regulated insurance infrastructure and claims processing.

products.name: Medical and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
products.description: Supplemental insurance policies covering hospitalization, outpatient services, surgeries, and related medical expenses not covered by national or major medical insurance, offered as individually underwritten or group products in Japan and the U.S. Delivered via agents, brokers, and corporate channels; requires regulated insurance operations.

products.name: Critical Illness and Critical Care Insurance
products.description: Insurance products providing fixed or lump-sum benefits upon diagnosis of specified critical illnesses (e.g., heart attack, stroke, cancer), available as riders or standalone policies for individuals and groups in both Japan and the U.S. Requires regulated insurance underwriting and claims management.

products.name: Accident Insurance
products.description: Supplemental insurance policies covering accidental death, dismemberment, specific injuries, and related hospital confinement, offered to individuals and groups in Japan and the U.S. Delivered through agents and brokers; requires regulated insurance infrastructure.

products.name: Short-Term Disability and Income Support Insurance
products.description: Insurance products providing income replacement or fixed benefits when policyholders are unable to work due to illness or injury, including short-term disability in the U.S. and income support in Japan. Delivered via agents and brokers; requires regulated insurance operations.

products.name: Life Insurance (Term and Whole Life)
products.description: Term and whole life insurance policies providing death benefits and, in some cases, cash surrender values, available as standalone or riders in Japan and the U.S. Requires regulated insurance underwriting and long-term capital management.

products.name: Dental Insurance
products.description: Fixed-benefit dental insurance policies covering dental procedures and services, offered to individuals and groups in the U.S. Delivered through agents and brokers; requires regulated insurance operations.

products.name: Vision Insurance
products.description: Supplemental vision insurance policies covering eye health conditions, corrective materials, and exams, offered to individuals and groups in the U.S. Delivered through agents and brokers; requires regulated insurance operations.

products.name: Annuities and Savings Insurance
products.description: Savings-oriented insurance products, including annuities and child endowment policies, providing lump-sum or periodic benefits at predetermined ages or events, primarily in Japan. Requires regulated insurance and investment management.

products.name: iLet Bionic Pancreas System
products.description: A fully automated, adaptive closed-loop insulin delivery system for people with insulin-requiring diabetes, integrating a proprietary pump, adaptive dosing algorithms, and a touchscreen interface. Manufactured in-house, it connects with leading continuous glucose monitors via Bluetooth and is distributed through direct sales and pharmacy channels.

products.name: iLet Bionic Pancreas System Supplies
products.description: Single-use consumables for the iLet system, including insulin cartridges and infusion sets, designed specifically for use with the iLet pump. These are manufactured and assembled internally and are required for ongoing device operation.

products.name: Mint Patch Pump (in development)
products.description: A next-generation, tubeless insulin patch pump featuring adaptive closed-loop automation, a reusable controller, and a disposable cartridge. Designed for large-scale manufacturing and smartphone control, targeting users seeking a discreet, wearable insulin delivery option.

products.name: Bihormonal iLet System (in development)
products.description: A forthcoming automated delivery system capable of administering both insulin and glucagon using adaptive closed-loop algorithms, intended to prevent and correct both high and low blood glucose levels. Includes a proprietary, pump-compatible, shelf-stable glucagon formulation developed in collaboration with Xeris Pharmaceuticals.

products.name: Online Firearms and Outdoor Gear Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform (GunBroker.com) facilitating the auction and sale of firearms, ammunition, hunting, shooting sports equipment, and related outdoor products between third-party buyers and sellers. The platform operates at scale, does not hold inventory (except branded merchandise), and ensures compliance with federal and state regulations through a network of licensed firearms dealers for legal transfers.

products.name: Advertising and Promotional Services for Sellers and Manufacturers
products.description: Digital advertising solutions offered to sellers, manufacturers, and service providers on the GunBroker platform, including banner ads, promotional emails, content development, and curated product showcases to increase visibility and drive sales within the outdoor and shooting sports communities.

products.name: Marketplace Analytics and Data Services
products.description: Provision of analytics tools (Outdoor Analytics) that deliver actionable insights to sellers, manufacturers, and industry stakeholders based on transaction and listing data from the GunBroker platform, supporting business decisions and market visibility.

products.name: Premium Collectibles Marketplace Tier
products.description: A specialized, curated marketplace tier (Collector’s Elite Platform) for rare and collectible firearms, offering exclusive listing formats and enhanced exposure for high-value items to attract discerning buyers and sellers.

products.name: Integrated Seller Financing Tools
products.description: Integrated financing options on the marketplace that enable sellers to offer flexible payment plans to qualified buyers, expanding purchasing power and facilitating higher-value transactions.

products.name: Client and Endpoint Solutions
products.description: A broad portfolio of higher-volume IT products for corporate and individual end users, including desktop PCs, notebooks, tablets, printers, components, peripherals, accessories, mobile phones, wearables, and mobility software. These products are sourced from leading technology vendors and delivered through a global distribution network.

products.name: Advanced Solutions
products.description: Enterprise-grade hardware and software products and related services for corporate and enterprise users, including servers, storage, networking, hybrid and software-defined solutions, cybersecurity, power and cooling, AI-related products, DC/POS, physical security, audio visual & digital signage, unified communications and collaboration, and IoT products. Delivery often involves project-based sales and professional services.

products.name: Cloud-Based Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of third-party cloud-based services and subscription offerings, including business applications, security, communications and collaboration, cloud enablement solutions, and infrastructure-as-a-service, delivered via the Ingram Micro Cloud Marketplace digital platform.

products.name: Professional Services and Support
products.description: Value-added services including pre-sales engineering, post-sale integration, technical support, training, business and market insights, and financing solutions, delivered to partners and customers to enhance adoption and value realization of IT solutions.

products.name: IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), Reverse Logistics and Repair Services
products.description: Services for electronic device reverse logistics, refurbishment, recycling, reuse, and resale, supporting environmental sustainability and enabling a circular economy. These services are provided to organizations including mobile telecommunication providers and other enterprises.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and investment in secured commercial real estate loans, including senior mortgage loans, mezzanine loans, B-notes, commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS), and debt-like preferred equity securities. These are structured, underwritten, and managed by a team of investment professionals, and are collateralized by various types of commercial real estate assets. Delivery requires significant financial capital, regulatory compliance, and in-depth underwriting and due diligence processes.

products.name: Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Solutions and Services
products.description: A suite of web-based software and outsourced services designed to optimize the financial operations of healthcare organizations, including claim management, eligibility verification, patient liability estimates, remittance management, denial/audit management, contract management, accounts receivable management, medical coding, and consulting. Delivered via cloud-based platforms and supported by managed service teams, these solutions require deep regulatory knowledge and integration with healthcare IT systems.

products.name: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Software Platforms
products.description: Comprehensive, integrated software systems (notably TruBridge EHR) for community hospitals and clinics, supporting clinical, financial, and administrative workflows. Delivered as on-premise or cloud-based (SaaS) solutions, these platforms automate patient management, clinical documentation, financial accounting, and enterprise operations, and are supported by ongoing software updates and maintenance.

products.name: Patient Engagement and Empowerment Solutions
products.description: Digital platforms and tools (such as InstantPHR and CHBase) that enable patients to access, contribute to, and manage their health information, integrate data from apps and devices, and communicate with providers. These solutions are delivered as web-based portals and APIs, supporting chronic disease management, wellness, and regulatory compliance for patient access.

products.name: Managed IT Services for Healthcare Organizations
products.description: A range of outsourced IT services including cloud hosting, backup and recovery, security, systems management, help desk, and collaboration tools, specifically tailored for healthcare enterprises to maintain advanced IT infrastructure, meet regulatory requirements, and reduce operational risk. Delivered by specialized teams and leveraging both domestic and offshore resources.

products.name: Healthcare Consulting and Business Management Services
products.description: Professional consulting services focused on operational assessment, process redesign, technology adoption, business intelligence, staffing, and interim or ongoing management for healthcare organizations. Delivered by experienced consultants, these services support clients in achieving efficiency, compliance, and strategic goals.

products.name: Encoder Solutions for Medical Coding
products.description: Knowledge-based software and services that support accurate and efficient medical coding for hospitals, payers, and consultants. These solutions provide coding guidance and references at the point of coding, improving productivity and compliance with healthcare regulations.

products.name: Healthcare Forms and Supplies
products.description: Provision of standard and customized forms and operational supplies necessary for patient and financial records, as well as for supporting server and peripheral equipment in healthcare organizations. These are physical products delivered to clients as part of a one-source solution approach.

products.name: Domo Cloud-Based AI and Data Products Platform
products.description: A comprehensive, cloud-based platform that integrates data collection, storage, preparation, analysis, visualization, automation, and distribution, with embedded AI and machine learning capabilities. Delivered as a SaaS solution, it enables organizations to connect to diverse data sources, transform and analyze data, and deploy AI-driven insights and workflows at scale, accessible via web and native mobile applications.

products.name: Data Integration and Connector Services
products.description: A suite of over 1,000 pre-built and universal connectors, including API and standards-based connectors, enabling real-time integration and synchronization of data from a wide range of cloud and on-premises sources. Delivered digitally through the Domo platform and Appstore, these services facilitate seamless data ingestion and interoperability.

products.name: Data Transformation and ETL Tools (Magic ETL)
products.description: Low-code and advanced data transformation tools (Magic ETL and Fusion) that allow users to combine, cleanse, and enrich data from multiple sources, including support for SQL, Python, and R scripting. Delivered as part of the Domo platform, these tools enable both business users and data professionals to prepare data for analysis and AI applications.

products.name: AI and Machine Learning Services (Domo AI)
products.description: A comprehensive AI and machine learning infrastructure, including model management, AutoML, Jupyter integration, and a hosted large language model (DomoGPT). These services enable customers to build, deploy, and manage AI models, apply AI-driven tasks (e.g., text generation, forecasting), and integrate AI into workflows and apps, all delivered via the Domo platform.

products.name: Data Analysis and Visualization Tools
products.description: A suite of analytics and visualization tools that allow users to analyze, display, and interact with data through customizable dashboards, charts, and visual stories. Delivered digitally via web and mobile, these tools support both out-of-the-box and custom visualizations, including integration with third-party libraries and advanced developer frameworks.

products.name: Embedded Analytics (Domo Everywhere)
products.description: A set of embedded analytics tools that enable organizations to securely deliver interactive data experiences, dashboards, and reports to external customers, partners, and vendors via portals, web properties, or inside applications. Delivered as a cloud service, it allows for branded, customizable, and secure data sharing.

products.name: Collaboration and Productivity Suite (Buzz)
products.description: A standalone collaboration and productivity suite integrated with the Domo platform, offering chat, sharing, organizational charts, project management, and real-time data-driven collaboration features. Delivered digitally, it fosters teamwork and engagement around business data.

products.name: Automation and Workflow Tools
products.description: Automation tools, including the Domo Workflow engine and Task Center app, that enable customers to automate business processes, integrate with external systems, and manage approvals and data-driven actions. Delivered as part of the Domo platform and via mobile apps, these tools support both low-code and custom code automation.

products.name: Custom Applications and Appstore Ecosystem
products.description: A marketplace (Domo Appstore) and development framework for custom business applications built on the Domo platform, including both internally developed and third-party apps. These apps address specific business needs, enable data-driven workflows, and can be distributed to all Domo users via the Appstore.

products.name: VIZZ (aceclidine ophthalmic solution) 1.44%
products.description: A once-daily, preservative-free, self-administered eye drop formulated with aceclidine, designed to restore clear near vision for up to 10 hours in adults with presbyopia. Manufactured using contract manufacturing organizations, filled in single-use Blow-Fill-Seal containers, and distributed via e-pharmacy partners and retail pharmacies.

products.name: AI Analytics Platform
products.description: A unified, subscription-based digital platform that integrates analytics, experimentation, activation, feedback, and AI-driven insights to help organizations analyze behavioral data and optimize digital products and experiences. Delivered as a cloud-based SaaS solution, it combines multiple modules for end-to-end product and marketing analytics, experimentation, and personalization.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Implementation, training, and consulting services to help customers design and execute AI analytics, product-led growth, and personalization projects. Delivered by in-house experts to accelerate customer onboarding and maximize value from the platform.

products.name: Cross-Border Payment Services
products.description: A digital platform enabling SMBs to send and receive payments globally in multiple currencies, leveraging a secure, regulated infrastructure and partnerships with banks and payment providers. Delivered via web and mobile applications, supporting local and international payment methods.

products.name: Billing and Accounts Receivable Services
products.description: Digital invoicing and AR tools that allow SMBs to create and manage invoices, collect funds from customers in multiple currencies, and accept payments via credit cards and local payment methods. Delivered through the Payoneer platform.

products.name: Physical and Virtual Card Solutions
products.description: Provision of branded physical and virtual cards that enable customers to access funds, make business purchases, and pay suppliers both online and in-store, including ATM withdrawals. Cards are issued via regulated entities and integrated with the Payoneer Account.

products.name: Checkout and Merchant Services
products.description: A digital checkout solution enabling SMBs to accept payments from global consumers via their web stores or integrated commerce platforms, unifying sales channels and payment flows. Delivered through the Payoneer platform and partnerships (e.g., Stripe).

products.name: Working Capital and Credit Solutions
products.description: Provision of working capital advances and lines of credit to SMBs, with amounts ranging from $500 to $10 million, either directly or via third-party lenders. Underwriting is supported by proprietary machine learning models.

products.name: Global Workforce and Payroll Management Services
products.description: A technology platform and service suite for onboarding, engaging, and paying international employees and contractors, including payroll processing and contractor management. Delivered digitally to SMBs hiring global talent.

products.name: Enterprise Mass Payout Services
products.description: Payment services for marketplaces and enterprise clients to pay sellers and service providers globally, supporting a broad set of localized and international payment methods including bank transfers, wires, e-wallets, and Payoneer cards.

products.name: On Device Solutions
products.description: A suite of products and services that simplify the discovery and delivery of mobile apps and content media to device end-users, leveraging proprietary technology and partnerships with wireless carriers and OEMs. Delivered through preloads, widgets, and native device experiences, it includes Application Media, Content Media, and user acquisition tools.

products.name: App Growth Platform
products.description: A digital advertising platform offering targeted mobile advertising and ad monetization solutions for app developers, brands, and agencies. It enables user acquisition, brand awareness campaigns, and monetization of app inventory via programmatic real-time bidding and direct campaign management tools.

products.name: Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS)
products.description: Physically manufactured uncrewed aerial vehicles (Groups 1-3) including small and medium UAS, delivered with ground control systems, spare parts, and accessories for military and commercial use. Includes products like Puma, Raven, VAPOR, JUMP 20, and T-20.

products.name: Counter-UAS and Precision Strike Systems
products.description: Integrated physical and digital systems for detecting, intercepting, and neutralizing hostile drones and targets, including loitering munitions (Switchblade, Red Dragon), radio frequency and kinetic counter-UAS products (Titan, Freedom Eagle), and electronic warfare solutions. Delivered as deployable hardware and software for defense applications.

products.name: Command and Control Software Platforms
products.description: Digital-only software platforms, such as Kinesis, for centralized command, control, and mission planning of uncrewed systems, integrating with various hardware to provide real-time situational awareness and automated mission execution.

products.name: Uncrewed Ground Systems (UGV)
products.description: Physically manufactured robotic ground vehicles for explosive ordnance disposal, hazardous materials handling, and tactical operations, featuring multi-axis manipulation and tool exchange. Includes products like tEODor EVO and Telemax EVO.

products.name: Unmanned Maritime Systems
products.description: Physically manufactured remotely operated and autonomous underwater vehicles for surveillance, reconnaissance, mine detection, and intervention tasks. Includes Defender, Pro 5, and Ally systems.

products.name: High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellites (HAPS)
products.description: Long-endurance, physically manufactured uncrewed aerial platforms operating at high altitudes for persistent communications and sensing over large areas, capable of carrying modular payloads.

products.name: Space-Based Platforms and Hardware
products.description: Physically manufactured, space-qualified hardware and systems for satellite communications, telemetry, missile warning, and ISR, including digital beamforming antennas (Badger, Wasp), line of sight stabilization, and control electronics for various orbits.

products.name: Laser Communications Systems
products.description: Physically manufactured high-bandwidth, secure laser-based data transmission payloads for space operations, enabling resilient, low-probability-of-intercept communications.

products.name: Directed Energy Weapon Systems
products.description: Physically manufactured high-energy laser weapon systems, such as Locust LWS, for tracking, identifying, and defeating aerial and ground targets, designed for modular deployment and integration onto various platforms.

products.name: Electronic Warfare Systems
products.description: Physically manufactured and software-enabled systems for RF signature analysis, automated detection, and identification of signals, supporting tactical communications, geolocation, and cyber effects. Includes products like SharkCage Tactical Chassis and BlueFin Angler SDR.

products.name: Cyber Operations Solutions
products.description: Digital and service-based solutions for offensive and defensive cyber operations, including analytics for GEOINT, SIGINT, MASINT, and OSINT, engineered for national security and defense applications.

products.name: Mission Systems and OSINT Analytics Platforms
products.description: Digital platforms and services, such as HaloCortex OSINT Platform, providing AI-powered open-source intelligence analysis and insights for defense and commercial customers.

products.name: Optical Transceivers and Data Interconnect Solutions
products.description: High-speed optical transceivers and data interconnect modules, including coherent pluggable transceivers, are manufactured using advanced photonic integration and semiconductor processes. These products are delivered as modules or subsystems to cloud data centers, AI/ML infrastructure, and network equipment manufacturers for high-capacity data transmission within and between data centers and networks.

products.name: Optical Components and Subsystems for Network Infrastructure
products.description: A broad portfolio of optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems, including high-speed laser transmitters, photonic integrated circuits, photodiodes, VCSELs, pump lasers, and passive components, manufactured using semiconductor and photonic technologies. These are supplied to cloud, telecom, and enterprise network operators to enable high-capacity fiber optic links across access, metro, long-haul, and submarine networks.

products.name: Optical Transport and Switching Solutions
products.description: Integrated modules, circuit packs, and subsystems for optical transport, including ROADMs, optical amplifiers, optical channel monitors, optical circuit switches, and wavelength management products. These are manufactured using photonic and electronic integration and are delivered to network operators to enable efficient switching, routing, and conditioning of optical signals in metro, long-haul, and data center networks.

products.name: Industrial Lasers for Manufacturing and Material Processing
products.description: A comprehensive range of industrial lasers, including kilowatt-class fiber lasers, solid-state lasers, ultrafast lasers, and diode lasers, manufactured using advanced laser and photonic technologies. These lasers are supplied to OEMs and manufacturers for precision material processing, micromachining, metal fabrication, semiconductor, solar cell, display, and electric vehicle battery production.

products.name: Laser Light Sources for 3D Sensing in Consumer Electronics
products.description: Laser light sources, primarily VCSELs and VCSEL arrays, manufactured using semiconductor processes and supplied to consumer electronics OEMs. These are integrated into 3D sensing cameras in smartphones, computers, and other devices to enable biometric identification, augmented/virtual reality, and computational photography.

products.name: Seafloor Mineral Exploration and Development Services
products.description: Odyssey provides specialized exploration, validation, and development services for high-value seafloor mineral resources, including project management, environmental studies, and extraction system design. These services are delivered through a combination of proprietary technology, marine operations, and expert personnel, and may be provided to subsidiaries, joint ventures, other companies, or governments.

products.name: Phosphate Ore Extraction and Fertilizer Production (Phosagmex Project)
products.description: Through the Phosagmex Project, Odyssey develops and operates subsea phosphate mining and processing for fertilizer production, involving ship-based dredging of offshore phosphate sands and processing into commercial fertilizer products for agricultural markets. This requires marine mining infrastructure, environmental permitting, and mineral processing capabilities.

products.name: Polymetallic Nodule Exploration and Development (Cook Islands Projects)
products.description: Odyssey participates in the exploration and development of deep-sea polymetallic nodule resources, primarily through equity interests and service provision in projects such as those with CIC Limited and Ocean Minerals LLC. Activities include resource validation, environmental assessment, and development of harvesting and processing systems for commercial metals. Operations are conducted in the Cook Islands' exclusive economic zone using advanced marine technology.

products.name: Subsea Gold Exploration and Development (Lihir Gold Project)
products.description: Odyssey explores and develops offshore gold resources through the Lihir Gold Project, which involves marine geological surveys, sampling, and environmental studies to validate and quantify subsea gold deposits. The project uses specialized vessels, remotely operated vehicles, and advanced mapping technologies in Papua New Guinea's exclusive economic zone.

products.name: U.S. Offshore Critical Minerals Exploration and Development
products.description: Odyssey is pursuing exploration and potential development of offshore critical mineral resources in the U.S. Outer Continental Shelf, focusing on heavy mineral sands containing titanium, zirconium, rare earth elements, and phosphate. This involves lease applications, environmental and geological data collection, and potential shallow-water dredging operations in collaboration with industry partners.

products.name: Dark Fiber and Conduit
products.description: Provides access to unlit optical fiber and underground conduit for customers to build and manage their own high-bandwidth, secure networks. Includes professional services for engineering and management. Delivery requires physical fiber infrastructure and engineering expertise.

products.name: Edge Cloud Services
products.description: Offers public and private cloud solutions leveraging network edge for low-latency, secure services, including cloud orchestration tools for dynamic workload management. Delivered via digital platforms and physical network edge infrastructure.

products.name: Internet Protocol (IP) Services
products.description: Delivers global internet access over a high-performance, diverse fiber network, including extensive off-net access solutions. Requires large-scale fiber optic infrastructure and network management.

products.name: Cloud Communications (VoIP and Unified Communications)
products.description: Provides cloud-based voice communications, SIP trunking, hosted voice, and unified communications platforms that integrate multiple communication tools into a single digital platform. Delivered via cloud infrastructure and managed services.

products.name: Managed Security Services
products.description: Delivers enterprise security solutions including DDoS mitigation, firewalls, consulting, management, and threat intelligence to secure customer networks. Requires specialized security infrastructure and expertise.

products.name: Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN)
products.description: Offers managed and co-managed SD-WAN solutions to automate and optimize connectivity across multiple network types, providing design, deployment, and ongoing management. Delivered via digital platforms and network infrastructure.

products.name: Optical and Ethernet Services
products.description: Provides high-bandwidth optical wavelength networks and ethernet-based networking services for point-to-point and multi-point data transmission across metro and wide area networks. Requires physical fiber infrastructure and network equipment.

products.name: VPN Data Networks and Private Line Services
products.description: Creates private, secure data networks and dedicated circuits for organizations, enabling secure transmission of voice, video, and data. Delivered via extensive fiber-optic network and dedicated infrastructure.

products.name: Traditional Voice Services
products.description: Offers traditional Time Division Multiplexing (TDM) voice services, including local, long distance, toll-free, and international calling. Delivered over legacy copper and fiber network infrastructure.

products.name: Equipment Sales and Installation
products.description: Sells and installs communications equipment to customers, often as part of broader network or service solutions. Involves physical product distribution and on-site installation services.

products.name: Managed and Professional Service Solutions
products.description: Provides technology consulting, software development, and ongoing management of customer-owned or acquired equipment and networks. Delivered through in-person expertise and digital solutions.

products.name: Legacy Data and Conferencing Services
products.description: Continues to provide services based on older platforms, such as SONET-based ethernet, legacy data hosting, and conferencing, to support customers transitioning to newer technologies. Delivered via legacy infrastructure.

products.name: Fiber Broadband Services (Mass Markets)
products.description: Provides high-speed broadband internet to residential and small business customers using fiber-based network infrastructure. Requires extensive fiber deployment and customer premises equipment.

products.name: Copper-Based Broadband Services (Mass Markets)
products.description: Offers lower-speed broadband internet to residential and small business customers using copper-based network infrastructure. Delivered over legacy copper lines and associated equipment.

products.name: Mass Markets Voice and Ancillary Services
products.description: Provides local and long-distance voice services, professional services, and other ancillary offerings to residential and small business customers, including participation in federal and state support programs. Delivered via legacy and digital infrastructure.
